pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Orion is a WebKit-based browser by Kagi, able to run Chrome and Firefox extensions. Upstream publishes Linux builds only as a Flatpak; this package unpacks that bundle and installs it as a native package, using the system GTK, GStreamer and GLib rather than a runtime image.
The payload is proprietary and bundles its own WebKit, which is pinned to older ICU and libjxl ABIs -- those come from dev-libs/icu-compat and media-libs/libjxl-compat.
